workflows.name: DOX — Self-Documenting AGENTS.md Framework
workflows.summary: Framework for giving AI agents precise project context through a hierarchical AGENTS.md documentation tree.
steps: 1. Copy AGENTS.md from agent0ai/dox into project root
2. Agent scans project, builds nested AGENTS.md tree indexing all directories
3. Before any edit: walk DOX tree from root → target path, read all AGENTS.md along the route
4. Use nearest AGENTS.md as local contract, parent docs for repo-wide rules
5. After meaningful change: update closest owning AGENTS.md, refresh Child DOX Index
6. If docs conflict, closer doc controls local details; no child doc may weaken DOX
7. Run existing verification when relevant; report intentionally unchanged docs

key_concepts.Core Contract: AGENTS.md files are binding work contracts for their subtrees
key_concepts.Hierarchy: Root AGENTS.md = project-wide rules + top-level index; children = domain-specific rules
key_concepts.Read Before Editing: Walk from root to target, read every AGENTS.md, use nearest as local contract
key_concepts.Update After Editing: Update docs when change affects purpose, scope, ownership, structure, workflows, rules, I/O, preferences, or doc tree itself
key_concepts.Closeout: Re-check changed paths, update docs, refresh indexes, remove stale text, run verification
